settings.heading: Here's who's behind it.
settings.copy: JasonL is an Australian commercial furniture company. Since 2008, we've supplied everything from home office desks to complete office fit-outs, delivered and installed by our own team.
settings.panel_heading: A few of the teams we've delivered to.
settings.panel_copy: These organisations have bought from JasonL. We're not claiming endorsement — just that they trusted us with the order.

settings.heading: Chat & measure
settings.copy: Tell us your headcount, floor and deadline. We'll come and measure — or work straight from your floorplan.

settings.heading: Free layout & quote
settings.copy: A real layout for your actual space, with an itemised quote. Yours to keep, no obligation.

settings.heading: We pick & deliver
settings.copy: Everything's in stock in our Australian warehouses — not on a ship. Our trucks, our schedule.

settings.heading: Installed & working
settings.copy: Our own installers build it, place it and take every box away. You walk in to a finished office.

settings.heading: Don't pick it part by part. Let's plan it.
settings.copy: Tell us the headcount and the space. We'll come back with a layout, a single quote and an install date — desks, chairs, storage, pods, the lot. One conversation instead of forty product pages.
settings.bar_copy: Stocked Australian warehouses and our own install crews. No middlemen, no shipping delays — it's logistics, not marketing.
